decisions.reason: The power-board component changes do not alter the requirement to review assembly settings, pricing, and component availability.
The source selects a JST-GH connector and changes R6, but it neither changes the existing sourceability policy nor reports that these components are unavailable.
The component and BOM changes do not modify the requirement that KiCad footprints resolve without unavailable local-library dependencies.
The 270Ω resistor changes concern the power-board LED circuit and R6, not the I2C pull-ups or series-resistor configuration.
The LED-circuit and R6 changes do not alter the AXP2101 USB input path or the required separation of VMID and VSYS.
